description: Header file defining the QConvoneDNNXPU class with static methods for quantized convolution operations on XPU devices within the ATen library, including different variants for pointwise and binary operations, prepacking, and dtype decision.

classes.name: QConvoneDNNXPU
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for quantized convolution operations on XPU devices.

methods.name: run_pointwise
methods.description: Performs a pointwise quantized convolution operation with tensor and scalar parameters.

methods.name: run_pointwise_tensor
methods.description: Performs a pointwise quantized convolution using tensor parameters for all inputs.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary quantized convolution operation with support for accumulators and scalar adjustments.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary_tensor
methods.description: Performs binary quantized convolution with tensor inputs for all parameters.

methods.name: qconv_decide_out_dtype
methods.description: Decides the output data type for quantized convolution based on inputs.

methods.name: qconv_prepack_xpu
methods.description: Prepares (packs) the convolution weights for efficient execution on XPU devices.
